context: NutriMetas is a nutrition management application that allows users to activate their accounts, access nutritional information, record data, and consult reports related to their healthy eating goals.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: Users can activate their accounts using their ID and password. They obtain the data for the goals that were previously defined and recorded by their nutritionist. This activation is performed only once per device using the password provided by the nutritionist. Once activated, the system will recognize the user each time they log in and will take them directly to the goals section. The prototype application does not synchronize between different devices belonging to the same user.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable user to activate account.; The system shall encrypt account and store account in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit account data in encrypted format to and from the authorized user.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted account data.
security_objectives.i:2: The system shall ensure that all mandatory information is provided for the account before activate.; The system shall protect against loss of information during activate.; The system shall have provision to report errors in account during activate.; The system shall have provision to report errors in account after activate.; The system shall have provision to correct errors in account if errors are detected.; The system shall ensure synchronization of account if multiple users can perform activate on account simultaneously.
security_objectives.ia:2: The system shall maintain a list of accounts for each user.;The system shall authenticate users based upon password.
security_objectives.ay:2: The system shall log every time user logs into and logs out of the system.; At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: user identification, timestamp, login/logout.; The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.; The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: When the user activates the application, the patient gains access to the information in their file previously defined by the nutritionist. This process loads the information onto the device.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable patient to access information in their file.; The system shall encrypt information in their file and store information in their file in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit information in their file data in encrypted format to and from the authorized patient.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted information in their file data.
security_objectives.i:1: The system shall ensure consistent understanding of information in their file by the patient during access.; The system shall have provision to report errors in information in their file during access.
security_objectives.i:2: The system shall ensure that all mandatory information is provided for the information in their file before access.; The system shall protect against loss of information during access.; The system shall have provision to report errors in information in their file during access.; The system shall have provision to report errors in information in their file after access.; The system shall have provision to correct errors in information in their file if errors are detected.; The system shall ensure synchronization of information in their file if multiple patients can perform access on information in their file simultaneously.
